whatThisTeaches: fixed hex topology with vertex camps and connected edge trails
seeded 2d6 production and an outcome-dependent seven path
engine-derived multi-player discard and targeted-response scheduling
private inventories, private discards, and participant-only random steals
repeated main actions, 3:1 depot exchanges, and bilateral offers
a complete normal-setup replay through immediate fourth-camp victory
whenToCopyThisPattern: Use this pattern for topology-driven games where placement legality depends on a growing connected network.
Represent roll-dependent branches as ordinary phases so inspect exposes only the decisions created by the actual result.
Use engine-derived barriers for multi-player obligations such as discards, then resume the interrupted turn after every response.

demoRelease.overview: Build a trail network across the fixed Stormtrail frontier, barter Timber, Brick, and Provisions, survive Bandits, and establish the first fourth camp.
